title: International Meeting
description: Give a concise update and surface a risk in a global team meeting.
scenario: You are giving a weekly update to colleagues in three countries.
initial_question: Give a short project update including progress, next step and one risk.
transfer_question: How would you ask the team for help with that risk?
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Keep the update brief, structured and action-oriented.
